- **Multiresolution Grid:** Stores spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients for each voxel or grid cell.
The grid structure allows for efficient access and interpolation during rendering.
**Preprocessing/Encoding:** For each relevant location in the volume, compute the local and global volumetric visibility.
This involves integrating the light transport from all light sources through the participating medium.
**SH Projection:** Project the computed visibility function (radiance or irradiance) onto spherical harmonic basis functions.
This converts the directional lighting information into a set of SH coefficients.
This grid acts as a precomputed transfer function or light cache.
**Rendering:** During real-time rendering, sample the SH coefficients from the multiresolution grid at the current ray-marching position.
Reconstruct the lighting contribution using the SH basis functions and the current view direction.
